name: Vitrines · Envoi des maquettes (gated)
description: Envoie les brouillons de vitrines validés par Basile (file vitrines_envoi, remplie par agents/vitrines.js). Source : n8n/vitrines_envoi.json du dépôt raime-cerveau.

parameters.query: SELECT mode, plafond_jour, from_email, from_name, test_to FROM vitrines_envoi_config WHERE id = 1

SELECT e.id, e.to_email, e.sujet, e.corps FROM vitrines_envoi e WHERE e.statut = 'a_envoyer' AND e.to_email IS NOT NULL AND lower(e.to_email) NOT IN (SELECT lower(email) FROM suppression WHERE email IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY e.cree_le, e.id LIMIT greatest(0, (SELECT plafond_jour FROM vitrines_envoi_config WHERE id = 1) - (SELECT count(*) FROM vitrines_envoi WHERE statut IN ('envoye', 'teste') AND envoye_le >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris'))
